title: Nemotron-Cascade 2: Post-Training LLMs with Cascade RL and Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: How might models like Nemotron-Cascade 2 redefine autonomy and reasoning in the next decade?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Cascade RL and on-policy distillation enable precise control, making 30B MoE models both powerful and efficient in real-world tasks.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But with increased autonomy comes risk—what happens when these systems make decisions beyond human oversight?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are embedding guardrails, using alignment techniques and human-in-the-loop systems to ensure safe deployment.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where AI agents collaborate with humans on complex challenges—climate modeling, healthcare, and more—with trust and transparency.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future hinges on balancing innovation with responsibility, ensuring progress serves all.
